potentialAggregations.currentName: Mixed: Bridge Host / Feishu Adapter / Mirror Runtime
potentialAggregations.potential: Bridge Host、平台 adapter、mirror feedback 仍被运行时编排和卡片更新耦在一起；潜在聚合应是 Bridge Host orchestration、Platform Adapter implementation、Mirror Runtime 三块，而不是一个更大的 bridge module。
potentialAggregations.targetShape: Bridge Host 保留启动/路由/生命周期入口；adapter 只拥有平台协议；mirror runtime 拥有 cursor/suppression/delivery 状态。
potentialAggregations.nextStep: 优先审计 bridge-manager 与 mirror/adapter 的双向边，寻找真实状态 owner；不要新建 bridge-composition 之类的大参数对象。
potentialAggregations.antiPattern: 禁止再造 composition/factory 依赖堆；应把状态机规则移到真实 owner，或把外部事实读取收成小而具体的端口。
evidence: top aggregates: Bridge Host 3895/17; Feishu Adapter 2882/1; Mirror Runtime 1319/4; Markdown Rendering 811/1

potentialAggregations.currentName: Mixed: Command Application / Execution Providers / Bridge Host
potentialAggregations.potential: Command Application 是 use-case switchboard；潜在聚合应按命令用户故事族和 rendering 分层，而不是每条命令单独碎片化。若它和 Execution Providers / Session Registry 被聚到一起，应优先收窄 command 对 provider、registry、display 的直接边。
potentialAggregations.targetShape: command execution、thread/session commands、diagnostics、presentation 分清边界；对 registry/display/codex 走窄接口。
potentialAggregations.nextStep: 先收窄 command 对 registry bindings 和 local Codex index 的直接 import，再考虑内部命名。
potentialAggregations.antiPattern: 禁止用空 facade 掩盖 command 出边；只有当命令用户故事入口更稳定、registry/display/codex owner 更清楚时才移动或拆分。
evidence: top aggregates: Command Application 4499/15; Execution Providers 1600/4; Bridge Host 998/5; Session Registry 929/3
hot files: src/lib/bridge/command/tmux.ts (840); src/codex/provider.ts (763); src/lib/bridge/command/session-thread.ts (713); src/codex/tmux-provider.ts (706)

potentialAggregations.currentName: Mixed: Local UI / Config / Service / Store / Persistence
potentialAggregations.potential: Local UI、config/service、store/persistence 混在 cluster-02；潜在聚合应拆为 Operator UI application、Configuration/Service Management、Persistence、Session Registry。
potentialAggregations.targetShape: UI 只编排 operator workflow；config/service 负责守护进程和配置；store/persistence 只负责数据读写和迁移；registry 拥有会话/绑定/default target 规则。
potentialAggregations.nextStep: 继续把 UI route 对 store/config 的直接读取改为 query/source/service；避免创建全局 UiComposition 或万能 context。
potentialAggregations.antiPattern: 禁止让 UI application 直接读取 config/store/local Codex 细节；应通过明确 query/source/service，而不是万能 app context。
evidence: top aggregates: Local UI 2107/12; Config / Service 1990/4; Store / Persistence 1281/2; Weixin Support 914/2
hot files: src/service-manager.ts (980); src/config.ts (861); src/store.ts (857); src/weixin/login.ts (697)

evidence: boundary assessment: 高耦合簇：职责相对集中，但与其他聚类交互很多，下一步应先定义对外端口。
